policy: Every requirement below is bound to a verbatim excerpt from the SIRI page named in source_roles. Nothing is paraphrased into an excerpt and nothing is inferred. No excerpt text was typed: each is resolved from LINE NUMBERS out of a numbered dump by scripts/visa-registry/excerpts-from-lines.mjs, which fails the file unless both the display and lowercase forms occur literally in the normalized text. That tool exists because B-33 shipped four verbatim excerpts of the wrong sentences.
structure_note:
The pay limit is the whole scheme, and two things about it decide outcomes.

FIRST, WHICH SALARY COUNTS. The authority names exactly three admissible components — liquid assets, labour-market pension contributions, and paid holiday allowance — and then names the benefits that look like salary and are NOT counted: canteen, car, phone, internet, and housing. Publishing the threshold without the exclusion list would let someone add DKK 60,000 of housing to a DKK 500,000 offer and believe they qualify.

SECOND, THE JOB-SEEKING TRAP. Losing the job revokes the permit, and a job-seeking permit must be applied for NO LATER THAN TWO DAYS after employment ends. Two days is short enough that a reader who learns it late has already missed it. Work is forbidden during that period, which is the opposite of what 'job seeking permit' suggests to most readers.
freshness_note: The page publishes no dateline. Its body states the 2026 pay limit explicitly ('The minimum amount for 2026 is DKK 552,000') and says the amount is regulated every 1 January, so the figure carries its own year and the next revision is visible as a text change. The daily sync is what will notice it.
not_extracted: The step-by-step application walkthrough (create a case order ID, pay the fee, complete AR1, employer completes their part). It is procedure for using SIRI's portal rather than a requirement of Danish law, and it changes with the portal.

The document checklists. The page publishes two — a general one and a separate, longer one for employment in hotels and restaurants — and they are extracted for no route in this batch. Publishing one and not the other would imply the hospitality checklist does not exist.
The rules for accompanying family members, which the authority describes on its own pages and which are a separate route.
Sideline employment, commuting, and external-examiner work, each of which the page links out to as a separate permit with its own conditions.

requirements.label: Annual salary must meet the pay limit — DKK 552,000 for 2026
requirements.description: The single defining condition of the scheme, with the year it applies to and the date it is re-set.
requirements.source_excerpt: you must have been offered a job with an annual salary that meets, at least, the minimum amount. the minimum amount for 2026 is dkk 552,000. the minimum amount is regulated every year on 1 january.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must have been offered a job with an annual salary that meets, at least, the minimum amount. The minimum amount for 2026 is DKK 552,000. The minimum amount is regulated every year on 1 January.

requirements.label: No educational background or professional field is required
requirements.description: What distinguishes this scheme from the Positive Lists, stated by the authority rather than inferred from their absence.
requirements.source_excerpt: it is not required that you have a specific educational background or that your job is within a specific professional field.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: It is not required that you have a specific educational background or that your job is within a specific professional field.

requirements.label: Only three salary components count towards the pay limit
requirements.description: The admissible components, quoted with the sentence that scopes them.
requirements.source_excerpt:
when assessing whether the salary that you have been offered meets, at least, the minimum amount, only the following salary components can be taken into account:

salary in the form of liquid assets, including fixed supplements which are, therefore, guaranteed salary

payments to labour market pension schemes, including the pension contributions paid by both the employer and the applicant

paid holiday allowance
requirements.source_excerpt_display:
When assessing whether the salary that you have been offered meets, at least, the minimum amount, only the following salary components can be taken into account:

Salary in the form of liquid assets, including fixed supplements which are, therefore, guaranteed salary

Payments to labour market pension schemes, including the pension contributions paid by both the employer and the applicant

Paid holiday allowance

requirements.label: Canteen, car, phone, internet and housing do NOT count towards the pay limit
requirements.description: The exclusion that decides borderline cases. Without it the threshold reads as reachable by adding benefits.
requirements.source_excerpt: your employer might offer you, as a supplement to your salary, benefits such as paid canteen, free use of car, paid phone, paid internet and paid living and housing expenses. note that these salary components cannot be taken into account when assessing whether your salary meets the minimum amount.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your employer might offer you, as a supplement to your salary, benefits such as paid canteen, free use of car, paid phone, paid internet and paid living and housing expenses. Note that these salary components cannot be taken into account when assessing whether your salary meets the minimum amount.

requirements.label: Unpaid holiday does not lower the threshold, and holiday allowance counts in the year it is paid
requirements.description: Two timing rules on the same figure, quoted together because the authority states them together.
requirements.source_excerpt: your annual salary must meet, at least, the minimum amount even if you take holiday without pay. if you earn holiday allowance, which can only be paid to you in the following year, it cannot count towards the annual salary for the year in which you have earned it. moreover, it is only holiday allowance paid by the employer whom you are currently allowed to work for, that can be counted as part of your salary.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your annual salary must meet, at least, the minimum amount even if you take holiday without pay. If you earn holiday allowance, which can only be paid to you in the following year, it cannot count towards the annual salary for the year in which you have earned it. Moreover, it is only holiday allowance paid by the employer whom you are currently allowed to work for, that can be counted as part of your salary.

requirements.label: Salary must be paid into a Danish bank account in your own name
requirements.description: The account must be in the applicant's own name at a bank legally operating in Denmark.
requirements.source_excerpt: your salary must be paid into a danish bank account in your own name, and the bank has to be operating legally in denmark.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your salary must be paid into a Danish bank account in your own name, and the bank has to be operating legally in Denmark.

requirements.label: The Danish bank account must be opened within 180 days
requirements.description: All three cases in one sentence: granted abroad, entering after grant, and already holding a permit valid 180 days or more.
requirements.source_excerpt: your danish bank account must be opened within 180 days of your residence and work permit being granted. if you enter denmark after you have been granted a residence and work permit, you must open a danish bank account within 180 days from your entry into denmark. if you already hold a danish residence permit that is valid for at least 180 days, your salary must be paid into your danish bank account from your first salary payment.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your Danish bank account must be opened within 180 days of your residence and work permit being granted. If you enter Denmark after you have been granted a residence and work permit, you must open a Danish bank account within 180 days from your entry into Denmark. If you already hold a Danish residence permit that is valid for at least 180 days, your salary must be paid into your Danish bank account from your first salary payment.

requirements.label: The offered salary must correspond to Danish standards
requirements.description: A second, separate salary test: meeting the pay limit does not satisfy it.
requirements.source_excerpt: the salary that you have been offered must not be inferior to the standards within the professional field in which you are going to work.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: The salary that you have been offered must not be inferior to the standards within the professional field in which you are going to work.

requirements.label: Terms of employment must correspond to Danish standards
requirements.description: Holiday entitlement and notice periods, assessed by the regional labour market councils where SIRI is in doubt.
requirements.source_excerpt: your terms of employment, such as your holiday entitlements, terms of notice, etc. must not be inferior to the standards within the professional field in which you are going to work.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: Your terms of employment, such as your holiday entitlements, terms of notice, etc. must not be inferior to the standards within the professional field in which you are going to work.

requirements.label: Working hours must be at least 30 hours a week
requirements.description: A part-time job at the full salary does not qualify.
requirements.source_excerpt: it is a requirement that your working hours are at least 30 hours a week.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: It is a requirement that your working hours are at least 30 hours a week.

requirements.label: The job must not be encompassed by a legal labour conflict
requirements.description: Quoted whole, because the same sentence carries the exception for other jobs at an affected employer.
requirements.source_excerpt: it is not possible to be granted a residence and work permit for a job encompassed by a legal labour conflict. it is, however, possible to be granted a permit for other jobs in a company or institution involved in a legal conflict, if the jobs, according to the applicable agreements between the labour market parties, are not encompassed by the conflict.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: It is not possible to be granted a residence and work permit for a job encompassed by a legal labour conflict. It is, however, possible to be granted a permit for other jobs in a company or institution involved in a legal conflict, if the jobs, according to the applicable agreements between the labour market parties, are not encompassed by the conflict.

requirements.label: A Danish authorisation is required for regulated professions
requirements.description: Applies before the permit can be granted, not after arrival.
requirements.source_excerpt: in some cases, before you can be granted a residence and work permit, it is required that you have a danish authorisation or a temporary authorisation for employment for adaption and training purposes.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: In some cases, before you can be granted a residence and work permit, it is required that you have a Danish authorisation or a temporary authorisation for employment for adaption and training purposes.

requirements.label: An accompanying family member must not have had a permit revoked more than once for lacking a work permit
requirements.description: A condition on the MAIN applicant's permit that depends on a family member's history, which is easy to miss.
requirements.source_excerpt: one of the conditions for a residence permit under the pay limit scheme is that your spouse, cohabiting partner, children or, in certain circumstances, other family members holding a residence permit as accompanying family members, have not had their residence permit revoked more than once due to lack of a required work permit.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: One of the conditions for a residence permit under the Pay Limit Scheme is that your spouse, cohabiting partner, children or, in certain circumstances, other family members holding a residence permit as accompanying family members, have not had their residence permit revoked more than once due to lack of a required work permit.

requirements.label: Processing fee
requirements.description: Payable before the application is submitted, to cover SIRI's case processing.
requirements.source_excerpt:
processing fee
dkk 6,810,-
requirements.source_excerpt_display:
Processing fee
DKK 6,810,-

requirements.label: Normal processing time, and the longer time if information is missing
requirements.description: Both figures quoted together, because the one-month figure alone reads as a commitment.
requirements.source_excerpt:
normal processing time
1 month

if further information is needed, the processing time can be up to
3 months
requirements.source_excerpt_display:
Normal processing time
1 month

If further information is needed, the processing time can be up to
3 months

requirements.label: One month before starting work — but only if you declare you can support yourself
requirements.description: Fourteen days without the declaration. The consequence sits in the same sentence as the condition.
requirements.source_excerpt: if you apply from abroad, you can be granted a residence permit valid for 1 month before you start working. it will give you the time to settle in denmark. when you apply, you must declare that you can support yourself and any accompanying family members during this time. if you do not declare this, your residence permit will be valid for 14 days before you start working.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you apply from abroad, you can be granted a residence permit valid for 1 month before you start working. It will give you the time to settle in Denmark. When you apply, you must declare that you can support yourself and any accompanying family members during this time. If you do not declare this, your residence permit will be valid for 14 days before you start working.

requirements.label: Four-year permit where the employment is four years or longer
requirements.source_excerpt: if your employment is for a period of 4 years or more, you will normally be granted a permit valid for 4 years. if you wish to continue to work after the first 4 years, you must apply for an extension of your residence and work permit based on the extension of your employment.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If your employment is for a period of 4 years or more, you will normally be granted a permit valid for 4 years. If you wish to continue to work after the first 4 years, you must apply for an extension of your residence and work permit based on the extension of your employment.

requirements.label: Shorter employment gives a permit for its duration, plus an automatic 6-month job-seeking permit
requirements.source_excerpt:
if you are employed for a shorter period than 4 years, your residence and work permit will normally be valid for the period of your employment. if you wish to continue working in denmark after this time, you must apply for an extension of your residence and work permit.

in addition, you will automatically be granted a 6 month job seeking permit allowing you to look for a new job in denmark.
requirements.source_excerpt_display:
If you are employed for a shorter period than 4 years, your residence and work permit will normally be valid for the period of your employment. If you wish to continue working in Denmark after this time, you must apply for an extension of your residence and work permit.

In addition, you will automatically be granted a 6 month job seeking permit allowing you to look for a new job in Denmark.

requirements.label: You are not allowed to work during the job-seeking period
requirements.description: The rule that most contradicts what the permit's name suggests.
requirements.source_excerpt: you are not allowed to work during your job seeking period.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You are not allowed to work during your job seeking period.

requirements.label: A residence permit can only be valid until 3 months before the passport expires
requirements.description: A short passport silently shortens the permit.
requirements.source_excerpt: a residence permit can only be valid until 3 months before the expiry date of your passport.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: A residence permit can only be valid until 3 months before the expiry date of your passport.

requirements.label: Apply for a job-seeking permit no later than two days after employment ends
requirements.description: The shortest deadline on the page, and the one a reader is most likely to learn too late.
requirements.source_excerpt: you must apply for a job seeking permit no later than two days after your employment ends.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must apply for a job seeking permit no later than two days after your employment ends.

requirements.label: Losing the job revokes the permit
requirements.description: Stated plainly by the authority; the six-month job-seeking permit is the remedy, not an automatic continuation.
requirements.source_excerpt: you must inform siri if you lose your job. your residence and work permit will be revoked as it is based on this exact job.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must inform SIRI if you lose your job. Your residence and work permit will be revoked as it is based on this exact job.

requirements.label: You must support yourself and may not receive benefits under the Active Social Policy Act
requirements.source_excerpt: you must be able to support yourself and your family during your stay. you are not allowed to receive benefits under the terms of the active social policy act, e.g. social security benefits.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must be able to support yourself and your family during your stay. You are not allowed to receive benefits under the terms of the Active Social Policy Act, e.g. social security benefits.

requirements.label: Giving up your Danish address or staying abroad over 6 successive months lapses the permit
requirements.source_excerpt: you must not give up your danish address or stay abroad for longer than 6 successive months. a violation will result in the lapse of your permit. this means that you will lose your right to stay in denmark.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: You must not give up your Danish address or stay abroad for longer than 6 successive months. A violation will result in the lapse of your permit. This means that you will lose your right to stay in Denmark.

requirements.label: The permit does not allow work in other Schengen countries
requirements.source_excerpt: in addition, a permit allows you to stay in the schengen area for up to 90 days within the latest 180 days period. the permit, however, does not allow you to work in other schengen countries.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: In addition, a permit allows you to stay in the Schengen area for up to 90 days within the latest 180 days period. The permit, however, does not allow you to work in other Schengen countries.

requirements.label: A sideline job requires a separate permit
requirements.source_excerpt: if you wish to take a sideline job, you have to obtain a separate permit.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: If you wish to take a sideline job, you have to obtain a separate permit.

requirements.label: As a general rule the employer must be a company registered in Denmark
requirements.description: Quoted with the exception the authority states in the same sentence.
requirements.source_excerpt: as a general rule, you must have an employment agreement with a company registered in denmark to be able to apply. however, there are certain exceptions, e.g. if you work for a foreign company that provides services in denmark.
requirements.source_excerpt_display: As a general rule, you must have an employment agreement with a company registered in Denmark to be able to apply. However, there are certain exceptions, e.g. if you work for a foreign company that provides services in Denmark.
